rule: The black/gray silhouettes are existing canonical screenshot-derived glyphs; colored direction lines are new suggestions, not recovered original stroke order; mirrors reflect drawing directions.

groups.name: Tall bowl with an angled upper cross-sweep
groups.description: Trace outer descent and return as one stroke; add upper angled connector as second stroke.
groups.caveat: Large screenshot-traced silhouette does not encode actual old stroke direction.

steps.name: Outer deep return
steps.description: Begin high left, curve around bottom and sweep up to the right.

steps.name: Upper diagonal sweep
steps.description: Start near upper left and draw angled sweep into right-hand neck.

groups.name: Large inward curl plus low wave
groups.description: Sweep long curl down and inward, then add independent curved lower underline.
groups.caveat: Trajectory and anchor points estimated from filled screenshot outline.

steps.name: Tall inward curl
steps.description: Start upper left, round the bowl and curl inward to finish near the center.

steps.name: Detached lower wave
steps.description: Draw short rising-then-dropping underline from left to right.

groups.name: Upper arc with folded lower fork
groups.description: One upper sweeping arch plus two lower connected-at-start gestures.
groups.caveat: Lower two strokes have common start. White number labels in proposal are offset; actual tips coincide. Three is a proposed practical ceiling.

steps.name: Upper arch
steps.description: Single arch upper left to upper right.

steps.name: Middle bend and descending hook
steps.description: From middle left, curl across and around right, then descend to lower tip.

steps.name: Inward folded branch
steps.description: Return to the same middle left starting point and draw the shorter inward arm.
